title: Fine Stone Concrete Pump for Floor Heating Backfill
seoTitle: Fine Stone Concrete Pump for Floor Heating Backfill | Pinjin
description: Xingtai catalogue matching for floor-heating backfill and fine-stone floor fill. Compare Electric Low Pressure 40, Electric 30 and Electric 15 using published aggregate, output and fine-stone distance — not hydronic design numbers.

answerBlock.what: A fine-stone concrete pump is a trailer pump matched to a mix whose stone stays inside the published max aggregate row. For floor-heating backfill we start from Electric Low Pressure 40 (37 kW, 12–15 m³/h, fine-stone 80 m / 240 m), Electric 30 (fine-stone 60 m / 180 m) or Electric 15 (1–3 cm stone, 8–10 m³/h). This page is not a heating-pipe design guide.
answerBlock.who: Contractors placing fine-stone floor fill or backfill on grid-powered sites who can state max stone size, pipe length and target output.
factors: Maximum aggregate versus the published row on the pump page
Fine-stone horizontal / vertical metres, not the number in the model name
Catalogue output (12–15 m³/h on LP40/Electric 30; 8–10 m³/h on Electric 15)
Trailer size and weight for indoor or courtyard access

faqs.question: Is floor-heating backfill the same as a mortar spray job?
faqs.answer: No. Floor fill that still contains stone is a pipeline pumping job. Mortar and plaster sprayers on /products/spraying-machines list particle ≤8 mm or ≤4 mm and are finishing machines, not trailer concrete pumps.

faqs.question: Which Pinjin pump is ‘the’ floor heating pump?
faqs.answer: None is named that in the catalogue. We match stone size and fine-stone distance: Low Pressure 40 for fine-stone 80 m / 240 m, Electric 30 for 60 m / 180 m, Electric 15 when 8–10 m³/h and 1–3 cm stone fit the short house window.

faqs.question: Do you publish floor-heating pipe spacing or fill thickness?
faqs.answer: No. Those are building-design figures. Send mix, max stone, pipe run and output with the inquiry. We only confirm whether they sit inside a published pump row.
